room.name: Keep the Borrowed Speed
room.hint: A downward cut rebounds without erasing sideways speed. Every dash swaps amber and blue.
room.question: Which part of your speed must survive the last contact?

bank.author: Codex
bank.solution: Launch beneath the low lintel with a hyper. Intercept the finite moth from above; its rebound adds height while preserving the fast horizontal departure. Reach the blue receiving shelf without spending the newly refreshed dash, which would phase the shelf away. Land on the shelf, then use the recovered footing for the final jump through the higher exit slot.
bank.nearestExisting: combat-04 Keep the Landing pairs pogo with a toggle landing; combat-10 The Living Stair sequences enemies. This low approach makes a grounded speed technique feed the same blade contact that supplies the missing vertical arc, while the receiving surface punishes discarding that speed for another dash.
bank.novelty: The target is a height conversion for already-earned horizontal speed. The refreshed dash is a tempting but destructive resource because it removes the only receiving floor.

route.movement: Existing Precision Core movement and blade interactions.

shortcutChecks.name: Use the renewed dash before landing
shortcutChecks.observed: The blue floor phases away. A late diagonal dash cannot reach the raised exit slot; the knight falls into its visible lower face.

shortcutChecks.name: Keep the hyper but omit the rebound
shortcutChecks.observed: Speed alone carries the knight underneath the receiving shelf and into the pit.

shortcutChecks.name: Ordinary jump and dash at the target
shortcutChecks.observed: The slower approach falls below the moth before making the intended downward contact.

bank.humanReview: Designer estimate only; user fun/difficulty/suitability ratings remain unmeasured. The hyper and preserved blade-contact momentum are an intended advanced route, not a claim that every possible advanced alternate was excluded.
